senses.gloss: काय (I) m.n. 1. The body, वहति विकलः कायो मोहं न मुंचति चेतना M.M.ix., Bg.v.10; 2. the trunk of a tree; 3. the body of a lute (the whole lute except the wires); 4. assemblage, collection; 5. a home, a habitation; 6. principal, capital; 7. a butt, a mark; 8. natural temperament.

काय (II) n. The part of the hand just below the fingers especially the little and the ring finger. It is regarded as the प्रजापतितीर्थ^1, M.ii.59.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260622. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/272.
काय (III) m. One of the eight forms of marriage, more generally known as प्राजापत्य q.v., Yaj.i.60.
काय-क्लेश m. bodily suffering or pain.
काय-चिकित्सा f. treatment of the diseases which affect the whole body.
काय-मान n. measurement of the body.
काय-स्थ m. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. the writer-caste proceeding from a क्षत्रिय father and a शूद्र mother; 3. a man of that caste, Yaj.i.336, Mrich.ix.
काय-स्था f. 1. a woman of this caste; 2. the myrobalan tree.
काय-स्थी f. the wife of a कायस्थ.
कायक a. (f. यिका) Relating to the body, bodily, corporeal, M.xii.8.
कायक a. (f. यिका) Relating to the body, bodily, corporeal, M.xii.8.

कायिका f. Interest (i.e. premium paid for the use of money).
कायिका-वृद्धि f. 1. interest consisting in the use of any animal or capital stock pawned; 2. interest of which the payment does not affect the principal.
